text.description_html:
RK International CK-311, White Porcelain Knob with Matching Base

White for decorating is gaining in popularity as is retro shapes and finish combinations and the White Porcelain Flat Cabinet Knob has both. The white porcelain knob's rose is available in two finishes. Choose from a polished chrome base for a clean, bright, and simple look or a polished brass base to accentuate the retro feel. This cabinet pull has a 1-1/4 inch diameter and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Black Porcelain Flat Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-311 White Porcelain Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
